# TouchLock — Play Store Listing

## App name (max 30 chars)
Touch Lock — Earbuds Control

## Short description (max 80 chars)
Lock touch gestures on Realme, OnePlus & OPPO earbuds with one tap.

## Full description (max 4000 chars)
Touch Lock lets you disable and restore touch gestures on Realme, OnePlus, and OPPO earbuds with a single tap — a feature the official apps don't offer.

No more accidental pauses, track skips, or ANC toggles when you're sleeping, lying on your side, or adjusting your earbuds. Lock the touch controls instantly, and restore them just as fast when you're ready.

★ ONE-TAP TOUCH LOCK
Lock both earbuds or each one individually. A Quick Settings tile lets you toggle from anywhere — no need to open the app.

★ FIND YOUR EARBUDS
Make your earbuds beep so you can locate them by sound. Or use the Find Nearby radar, which shows signal strength and compass direction to guide you to your lost earbuds.

★ GESTURE CUSTOMIZATION
Customize individual touch actions — double tap, triple tap, long press — for each earbud independently.

★ BATTERY AT A GLANCE
See battery levels for each earbud and the charging case right on the home screen.

★ WORKS WITH
• Realme Buds Air 8
• OnePlus Nord Buds 3 Pro
• And likely other OPPO/Realme earbuds sharing the OPOv1 protocol (OPPO Enco Air, Realme Buds T100/T110/T200/T300, and more)

★ NO ADS, NO TRACKING
Touch Lock is free, open source, and collects zero data. No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry. Your phone talks directly to your earbuds — nothing more.

A optional one-time "Supporter" purchase is available if you'd like to support development.

★ OPEN SOURCE
The full source code is available on GitHub: github.com/sarvesh/realme-buds-touchlock
